page.layout: One page of text within an ornamental woodcut border; no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left of the text block. Scan also shows show-through from the facing page at the right edge, which is left out.

main_text.p: adhuc vetustius exemplar extat in Bibliotheca Schobingeriana S. Galli, cui Medicum nobilissimum Dn. Sebastianum Schobingerum à morte clarissimi viri, agnati ejus Dn. Bartholomæi J. U. D. præesse memini. Cum his congruunt aliquomodo quinque illæ Tincturæ particulares quæ feruntur corticeis libellis inscriptæ, ex uno ferè cum prioribus fundamenti genere procedentes, sed in eis purum ab impuro terrestri non separatur. Contra quàm apud Monachum videre est, qui terram leprosam abjicere docet, quò fit ut ejus Tincturas particulares tantò necesse sit præstantiores reddi, & magis maturescere, & plus tingere, quantò illas subtilitate vincunt.
Sed ad Comitem Bernhardū ex Mar-

page.notes: Printed text is in the old spelling with long s rendered as s; "priorib⁹" read as prioribus. Some letters in the lower lines are faint, "reddi" and "tingere" are as printed. The ornamental border is not transcribed.
